---
title: "Missing data"
---

Steps that handle missing values before anything else touches the frame (the
grouping follows [Feature Engineering A–Z](https://feaz-book.com/)). In the
[eight-position ordering](../basics/four-stages-eight-steps.qmd) these fill
[Missing: impute](../four-stages/missing-impute.qmd) and
[Missing: category levels](../four-stages/missing-category-levels.qmd), the
whole of stage 1.

Steps to know:

- `StepImputeMedian` — fill numeric nulls with the training median
  (`StepImputeMean` is the mean-flavored sibling).
- `StepImputeMode` — fill categorical nulls with the most frequent level.
- `StepUnknown` — give missing categorical values their own explicit level
  instead of filling them in, so "missing" becomes something the model can
  learn from (also at home in
  [categorical features](categorical-features.qmd)).
- Missing-data indicator columns, so the model can learn from *where* values
  were missing — planned, see
  [#209](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/issues/209).

*Stub — content to come.*
